The cardiac cycle consists of systole (contraction) and diastole (relaxation). Of the two options in the team note, "systole, diastole, and rest" and "contraction, relaxation, and rest", I'd pick the first, since it uses the standard terms and the "rest" phase corresponds to the quiescent period (diastasis) at the end of diastole. Both options describe the same three phases, so my choice between them is about wording, not content.

CONFIDENCE: 66
